bias.en: Bearish · three-day slide broke the 200-day, RSI under 30
bias.zh: 偏空 · 三连跌跌破 200 日均线，RSI 低于 30

read.en: Marvell fell 12.7% on Nov 2 to $171.41 (range $168.52–192.30) on 2.7 times average volume, a third straight drop. It is below the falling 5-day ($216.27), 10-day ($225.23), 30-day ($249.84) and 100-day ($237.57), and now below the rising 200-day ($183.65). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 29 ($251.12), and RSI is 29.
read.zh: Marvell 11月2日下跌 12.7%，收于 $171.41（区间 $168.52–192.30），成交量为均量的 2.7 倍，为连续第三天下跌。股价位于下行的 5 日（$216.27）、10 日（$225.23）、30 日（$249.84）和 100 日均线（$237.57）下方，并已跌破上行的 200 日均线（$183.65）。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月29日起看空（$251.12），RSI 为 29。

read.en: The drop broke all three written supports, $188.3–190.2, the 200-day ($183.2) and the $178 Jul 17 low, now resistance. Resistance is $178–183.7 (Jul 17 low, 200-day), then $190.2–192.3 (Oct 30 low, Nov 2 high) and $200.6–207.6. Support is $168.5–170.8 (Nov 2 low, Apr 24 high), then $162.9 (Jul 29 low) and $158 (May 12 low). A close above $183.7 would target $190–192; below $168.5, $163.
